about: The ten spells (Noah's list): each its own colour, projectile, left-click attack (tap; hold to charge the one hand for an empowered shot) and right-click charged attack (both hands build one orb between them; release at full power). Damage numbers are in BO3 units like the weapons sheet. Sounds per stage come from the weapons row of the same id (kGunSounds, Spec 12.3). Visuals: tools/spellfx.py writes Meshes/CurseOfAlduin/fx/<id>_{bolt,orb,beam,hand,burst}.nif in these colours. Code: src/Spellcraft.inl.

columns.id: weapons-sheet row this spell lives in (slots, mana, the box)
columns.name: shown everywhere
columns.color: the spell's colour (hands, projectile, orb, beam, HUD) as RRGGBB
columns.style: visual family: arcane fire ice shock thorn blood wind soul dawn void
columns.tap: left click: bolt | fan | chain | gust | wisp
columns.homing: turn rate toward the nearest foe (0 = straight)
columns.effect: what a left-click hit does besides damage: none ignite freeze chain poison drain push holy pull shatter (freezes; a frozen foe hit again bursts)
columns.ult: right-click charged attack: lance mortar nova thunder roots bloodnova windball soulstorm sunburst singularity | the wonders: gravecall cataclysm wolfpack warhost
columns.ultRadius: its radius (area attacks) or beam width
columns.text: one line for the HUD and the spell menu

rows.name: Grave Spark
rows.text: Fast arcane bolts. Charged: a held beam of force that pierces the line.

rows.name: Emberbrand
rows.text: Fire bolts that set the dead alight. Charged: a lobbed fireball that bursts and burns.

rows.name: Cryo Freeze
rows.text: An ice beam that freezes a foe solid for 5 seconds. Charged: a nova that freezes everything near.

rows.name: Stormcaller
rows.text: Lightning that leaps between the dead. Charged: a thunderbolt called down from the sky.

rows.name: Bramble Spike
rows.text: A spray of poison thorns. Charged: roots burst up and hold the dead in place.

rows.name: Bloodreaver
rows.text: Drain bolts that heal you. Charged: a blood nova round you that feeds on every foe it hits.

rows.name: Gale
rows.text: A gust that cuts down three or four of the dead. Charged: a wind ball that bursts and flings them far.

rows.name: Soulwisp
rows.text: Wisps that seek the dead. Charged: six wisps hunt down a crowd.

rows.name: Dawnlight
rows.text: Holy light that sears the undead. Charged: a sunburst that blinds and burns a wide circle.

rows.name: Voidcall
rows.text: A slow void orb that drags the dead in. Charged: a black hole that pulls them together and collapses.

rows.name: Gravecaller
rows.text: Grave-wisps that hunt the dead and feed you their life. Charged: the barrow answers - three bone warriors claw out of the ground to fight for you.

rows.name: Frostbinder Gauntlets
rows.text: Ice that binds what it strikes - and shatters what is already bound. Charged: everything round you freezes, then bursts.

rows.name: Wolf Queen's Crown
rows.text: Spirit-wolves that run down the dead in pairs. Charged: the Queen howls and her pack of spectral wolves runs at your side.

rows.name: Horn of the Barrow-Jarls
rows.text: A war-cry that hurls the dead back in a wave. Charged: the old war-host of the barrows charges down the line in front of you.
